scenarios.title: Valid 3-day Huế request passes input validation
scenarios.rule: Structurally valid input is accepted unchanged; destination kept as typed.

scenarios.title: Valid 3-day Huế request generates a candidate (Gemini)
scenarios.rule: Generation returns a CandidatePlan with status UNVERIFIED; never FEASIBLE.

scenarios.title: Valid 3-day Huế plan (dataset-grounded) evaluated
scenarios.rule: Travel matrix rows are 'unverified' and transport/accommodation costs are unknown, so the plan must not be FEASIBLE.

scenarios.title: Valid 3-day Huế plan ranked
scenarios.rule: An UNVERIFIED plan is excluded from ranking, never recommended.

scenarios.title: ATTR_H_08 (Làng Hương Thủy Xuân, opens 09:00) scheduled at 08:30
scenarios.rule: An activity must sit inside one opening window (feasibility_rules.md TPVA-24).

scenarios.title: Plan has no travel legs between consecutive activities
Known ticket costs exceed a 300,000 VND group budget
scenarios.rule: Known costs (375,000/person x 2 = 750,000) already prove the violation even with unknown transport/lodging.

scenarios.title: perPerson budget 300,000 x 2 travellers vs 750,000 known costs
scenarios.rule: perPerson budget is multiplied by travelers.count (600,000 < 750,000).

scenarios.title: Dining stop REST_H_01 has no price in the dataset
scenarios.rule: Unknown food price stays null/NO_DATA; cost result UNVERIFIED, never 0.

scenarios.title: Two activities on day 1 overlap (08:00-11:00 and 10:30-12:00)
scenarios.rule: Overlapping activities are rejected (M3 grounding: no overlap) or INFEASIBLE (M4).

scenarios.title: betweenActivities limit 10 min; day-2 leg is 22 min (dataset, unverified)
scenarios.rule: Over-limit legs are INFEASIBLE only on verified data. Huế matrix rows are 'unverified', so the honest result is UNVERIFIED; a confirmed INFEASIBLE needs verified routes (M2).

scenarios.title: Same place ATTR_H_03 visited twice in a row on day 1
scenarios.rule: A repeated stop must be flagged (a check or a 422), not silently accepted.

scenarios.title: Malformed JSON body to /itineraries/evaluate
scenarios.rule: FastAPI default {detail:[...]} 422; no 500, no stack trace.

scenarios.title: Malformed JSON body to /api/v1/requests/validate
scenarios.rule: Malformed JSON is a 422, never a 500.

scenarios.title: No destination: input validation keeps destination empty
No destination: generation should suggest a destination
scenarios.rule: Product decision: a skipped destination means the AI suggests one from the other constraints (TPVA-39/40, PR #50).

scenarios.title: Unsupported destination 'Atlantis' is rejected with 422
scenarios.rule: Unsupported destination is not silently replaced by another city.

scenarios.title: OSRM enabled, provider never answers (timeout)
scenarios.rule: Provider failure stays unknown evidence (osrm-routing.md); no 500, not FEASIBLE.

scenarios.title: transportation contains a number instead of a string
scenarios.rule: Schema: transportation is a list of non-empty strings.
